description: Strength of Mount Mugamba Level 60 Hail, <class>. I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will. Wear this talisman around your neck, <class>. Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!
name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
